contextReview.basis: Direct review: cloudy night harbour promenade with warm stucco walls, wall lamps and moored boats; no rain depicted (dry-looking paving); humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The black shorts and charcoal full-length tights are separate products. Hidden backs, the inner top body under the shell and soles are inferred. The map on the wall is a scene prop. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All28 viewed on4 backgrounds: no opaque rectangles, obvious halos or clipping. Shoe pairs aligned overhead; socks paired; watch and cap complete. Hidden details conservative, no brand/verified-performance claim.

deck.ko: 오렌지 한 색과 차콜의 긴 선.
deck.en: One orange note above a long charcoal line.
deck.de: Ein orangefarbener Akzent über einer langen Anthrazitlinie.

intro.ko: 지도 옆에서 길을 가리키며 한 번 웃어 보이는 밤입니다.
intro.en: Beside the map, he points down the lane with a quick smile.
intro.de: Neben der Karte zeigt er lächelnd in die Gasse.

body.ko: 오렌지 후드 셸 아래 차콜 톱을 넓게 드러냈습니다. 검정 쇼츠와 차콜 타이츠는 짧고 긴 선을 겹치고 회색 러닝화가 발끝을 정리합니다. 은색 어깨·소매 선은 플래시에 반응하고, 재킷 밑단을 붙잡은 손은 작은 바람을 설명합니다. 지도는 장면의 계기일 뿐 착장 제품은 아닙니다.
body.en: The orange hooded shell opens over a broad charcoal center. Black shorts and charcoal tights layer short and long lines, finished by gray running shoes. Silver shoulder and sleeve lines respond to the flash; the hand catching the jacket hem explains the little breeze. The map prompts the scene rather than joining the outfit.
body.de: Die orange Kapuzenjacke öffnet sich über einer breiten anthrazitfarbenen Mitte. Schwarze Shorts und Tights verbinden kurze und lange Linien, graue Laufschuhe schließen ab. Silberne Schulter- und Ärmellinien reagieren auf den Blitz; die Hand am Saum erklärt die kleine Brise. Die Karte ist Anlass der Szene, kein Teil des Outfits.

tip.ko: 검정 쇼츠와 차콜 타이츠 사이 명도 차이를 남기세요.
tip.en: Leave a slight tonal difference between black shorts and charcoal tights.
tip.de: Schwarze Shorts und Anthrazit-Tights leicht im Ton unterscheiden.
